correctness.rationale: For H_n=K_n corona K_1 (n>=2), any chosen pendant leaf v_i prime and core mate v_i together with a third vertex w form a forbidden geodesic triple since every v_i prime-to-w shortest path passes internally through v_i. Conversely, if at most one from every pendant pair is chosen, all geodesic internal vertices between selected endpoints are the absent core mates of selected pendant endpoints: no forbidden triple for |S|>=3. Sizes 0,1,2 are always admissible; hence psi(H_n;x)=(1+2x)^n+n*x^2. The affected coefficient differences are a1^2-a0*a2=2n^2+n, a2^2-a1*a3=n^2(4n^2+12n-13)/3 when a3 exists, and a3^2-a2*a4=2n^2(n-1)(n-2)(2n^2-3n+7)/9 when a4 exists; they are positive. For other interior indices scaled binomial strict log concavity applies, with n=2,3 edge cases direct. Thus all n>=2 strictly log-concave; finite enumeration is not used to prove the all-n statement.
residual_risks: Applies only to K_n with one leaf at each core vertex; not all corona products.
